dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Exactly, exactly! I've got all the latest scoop on things happening in Inazuma right here — the freshest intel, if you will.

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: I mean, have you heard? The Vision Hunt Decree has been abolished! Those who once had their Visions confiscated can now use their elemental abilities again!

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: You know what? It almost feels like a game, this whole "having elemental abilities" business.
